package.name: mongla_localization
package.description: Where the vehicle is, and which way it faces. The estimation layer that sits between perception and control: the invariant filter, the landmark heading anchor, prop resection, and the pose fuser that decides which PnP branch to believe. Split out of mongla_vision because none of it is about pixels -- every one of these takes measurements in and produces a pose, and keeping them beside the detector made both harder to read.
